blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding how objects move in dynamic scenes requires recovering their 3D motion from visual observations and predicting their positions at unobserved times. Existing methods either optimize scene-specific velocity fields or impose predefined physical and kinematic assumptions. We instead study learning a continuous-time dynamics operator across scenes, mapping multi-view visual observations to 3D object kinematics. We introduce Adaptive Pixel Flows (\ours{}), which learns this operator from multi-view RGB-D observations without per-scene optimization or predefined motion models. The method fuses observations from all cameras into a shared voxel grid in world coordinates, from which the network predicts a continuous-time velocity field. Because the operator is trained across scenes, it learns motion priors that carry over to unseen scenes. The field can then be integrated from observed states to predict object positions between observations and beyond the observed sequence. On held-out PhysInOne scenes, \ours{} improves F1 over the strongest competing method by 2.5\% for in-between prediction and 15\% for future prediction. Compared with per-scene velocity-field methods, the improvements are 30\% and 85\%, respectively. Applied zero-shot to Spring-Gaus, it improves future-prediction F1 by 12\%.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Predicting how objects move, such as a swinging pendulum, a spinning panel, or an object dropping into liquid, is a key task in animation, simulation, mixed reality, and robotics [ 21 , 4 , 1 , 10 , 19 , 51 , 32 ] . Dynamic reconstruction methods recover such motion from video by fitting a time-varying 3D representation to each scene. This can include deformed canonical space, factorized spacetime volume, or trajectories of 3D Gaussians [ 39 , 35 , 3 , 12 , 54 , 47 , 31 , 44 , 20 ] . Feed-forward 3D trackers [ 49 ] and 4D reconstruction models [ 55 ] infer time-varying geometry and correspondences across scenes without per-scene fitting. These methods can be queried at any time within the observed sequence, but they do not model the dynamics that would predict how the scene evolves after it.
blocks.zh: 预测物体如何移动,如摇摆的圆柱形,旋转面板,或物体掉入液体,是动画,模拟,混合现实和机器人[21,4,1,10,19,51,32]的关键任务. 动态的重建方法通过给每个场景安装一个时长的3D表示器来从视频中恢复这种运动. 这可以包括变形的舟体空间,因子化的空间时积,或者3D高斯的轨迹[39,35,3,12,54,47,31,44,20]. feed-forward 3D trackers [49] 和 4D 重建模型 [55] 推断时间变化的几何和横跨场景的函射,没有每个场景的适合性. 这些方法可以随时在观测到的序列内被问及,但是它们并不模拟能够预测场景之后如何演变的动态.

blocks.en: A complementary line of work focuses on explicitly modeling scene dynamics. Some methods represent motion through learned velocity fields [ 22 , 24 , 30 ] or per-particle dynamics [ 23 ] . Others recover material parameters from visual observations to drive differentiable physical simulators [ 25 , 58 , 16 ] , or specify these parameters manually [ 50 ] . While these approaches provide a more explicit account of temporal evolution, they are often optimized independently for each scene and rely on a prescribed model of the underlying dynamics. Recent video-based dynamics models [ 57 , 56 , 45 ] learn dynamics that transfer across scenes or object instances, but remain tied to specific material or object categories, or rely on pretrained world-model representations.
blocks.zh: 一个互补的工作领域侧重于明确模拟场景动态。 有些方法通过学习到的速度场[22,24,30]或每粒子动力学[23]来表示运动. 其他人从视觉观测中回收材料参数,以驱动不同的物理模拟器[25,58,16],或手动指定这些参数[50]. 虽然这些方法更明确地说明了时间演化,但它们往往为每个场景独立优化,并依赖一个规定的基本动态模型。 近期的基于视频的动态模型[57,56,45]学习了跨越场景或物体实例的动态,但仍与特定材料或物体类别挂钩,或依赖经过预先训练的世界模型表现.

blocks.en: A different modeling perspective is to treat 3D dynamics as a direct parameterization of visual observations, rather than scene-specific or material-specific models. In this paradigm, one can learn the representation space for a continuous-time dynamics operator that can generalize across physical systems and scenes. Inspired by the operator-learning philosophy [ 26 , 29 , 43 ] , we seek a representation of such an operator that admits zero-shot evaluation on previously unseen scenes, without material-specific modeling.
blocks.zh: 一个不同的建模视角是将3D动态作为视觉观测的直接参数化,而不是场景特异性或材料特异性模型. 在这个范式中,人们可以学习一个可以跨越物理系统和场景的连续时动态操作员的表示空间. 在操作者-学习哲学[26,29,43]的启发下,我们寻求这样的操作者的代表,承认在以前不见的场景上进行零镜头评价,而不采用特定材料的模型.

blocks.en: Concretely, we consider kinematics through a continuous-time 3D velocity field that describes the evolution of object positions. Learning such a field directly from video presents a fundamental challenge: the motion between and after observations may be underdetermined by the observations themselves, because visual observations may be entangled with viewpoint and occlusion or be sparsely sampled. Thus, the field must draw on priors learned across scenes. Addressing the entanglement with viewpoint and occlusion further requires a representation in which scene geometry and motion can be expressed independently of the viewing configuration.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,我们通过描述物体位置演变的连续时间3D速度场来考虑动因学. 直接从视频中学习这样一个领域是一个根本性的挑战:观察之间和之后的动作可能因观察本身而决定不足,因为视觉观察可能与观点和隐蔽性缠绕在一起,或者很少取样. 因此,实地必须利用从场景中吸取的以往经验。 要用视角和隐蔽来解决缠绕问题,还需要一种表达方式,使场景几何和运动可以独立于取景配置来表达.

blocks.en: Our key insight is to learn the dynamics operator on a volumetric fusion of the observations. This expresses scene states in one world coordinate frame shared by all cameras, rather than in the image coordinates of each view. We draw from the longstanding use of volumetric fusion to combine multiple views into a common representation, from depth fusion [ 9 , 33 ] to perception across arbitrary camera rigs [ 38 ] . With calibrated multi-view RGB-D observations providing the geometric grounding, we describe scene evolution through the 3D motion of back-projected visual observations, which we term Adaptive Pixel Flows (AdaPixFlow) . As illustrated in Figure 2 , AdaPixFlow parameterizes this motion using an observation-conditioned continuous-time 3D velocity field, along which the back-projected object points are evolved through differentiable advection. This enables continuous-time prediction of object positions both between observations and beyond the observed sequence. Figure 1 shows predictions on a held-out scene.
blocks.zh: 我们的关键洞察力是学习动态操作器 对观测结果进行量子结合。 这表示一个世界中的场景状态,所有相机共享的坐标框架,而不是每个视图的图像坐标. 我们从长期使用量子聚变把多种观点综合到共同代表,从深度聚变[9,33]到跨越任意摄像机的感知[38]. 通过校准的多视图RGB-D观测提供了几何定位,我们通过后投影视觉观测的3D运动来描述场景演化,我们称之为适应像素流(AdaPixFlow). 如图2所示,AdaPixFlow参数使用一个观测条件的连续时间3D速度场对这个运动进行参数化,在此过程中,后投影对象点通过不同的对流演化. 这使得能够连续地预测观测到之间和观测到的序列以外的物体位置。 图1显示了一个搁置场景的预测.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We introduce a continuous-time dynamics operator that, trained once across scenes, predicts the 3D motion of objects in unseen scenes from sparse multi-view RGB-D observations. • We formulate the dynamics on a fused voxel grid, in which the back-projected object pixels are advected along a predicted velocity field, and train it through the advection without velocity labels or ground-truth point correspondences. • We evaluate AdaPixFlow on held-out PhysInOne [ 59 ] scenes and test its zero-shot generalization on Spring-Gaus [ 58 ] , PhysGaia [ 17 ] , and Kubric-4D [ 42 , 13 ] . Across these benchmarks, we compare against per-scene dynamics models and adapted 4D reconstruction and tracking methods. On PhysInOne, AdaPixFlow improves F1 over the strongest competing method by 2.5% for in-between prediction and 15% for future prediction, with gains of 30% and 85% over per-scene velocity-field methods. Without additional training, it improves future-prediction F1 on Spring-Gaus by 12% and in-between prediction F1 on PhysGaia by 5%, while achieving competitive performance on Kubric-4D, including against methods trained on that benchmark.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Dynamic reconstruction and tracking. Neural radiance fields and 3D Gaussian splatting have enabled dynamic scene representations based on canonical-space deformations, factorized spacetime representations, and time-dependent Gaussian trajectories [ 39 , 36 , 11 , 3 , 53 , 31 ] . Subsequent work recovers 4D geometry and motion from monocular video [ 44 , 20 ] , while feed-forward methods extend reconstruction and tracking to unseen scenes [ 49 , 14 , 55 ] . More recently, Trace Anything [ 28 ] and Uni4R [ 52 ] have introduced continuous-time 3D point queries. Trace Anything predicts, for each pixel, a cubic B-spline trajectory with a fixed number of control points over the normalized time span of its input frames, which may be sparse or unordered. It forecasts by continuing a trajectory along its tangent rather than with a learned dynamics model. Uni4R predicts per-pixel 3D velocities from features interpolated between two consecutive frames and integrates them over that interval. Under this frame-pair formulation, every query needs the frame after it, so Uni4R does not predict beyond the last input frame. AdaPixFlow instead learns a continuous-time dynamics operator in a shared 3D space, enabling motion prediction both between sparse observations and beyond the observed sequence.
blocks.zh: 动态重建与跟踪. 神经辐射场和3D高斯电镀使得基于犬形-空间变形的动态场景表现功能得以实现,因素化的时空表现,以及时间依赖的高斯轨道[39,36,11,3,53,31]. 随后的作品从单视视频中恢复了4D几何和运动[44,20],而向导方法则将重建和跟踪扩展至看不见的场景[49,14,55]. 最近,Trace Anything [28] 和Uni4R [52]引入了连续时间3D点查询. 追踪 任何事情都预言,对于每个像素来说,一个立方的B-spline轨迹,在其输入框架的正常时间段上都有固定的几个控制点,这可能是稀疏的或无序的. 它的预测方式是沿着其紧要的轨迹继续前进,而不是采用学习到的动态模型。 Uni4R预测每个像素的3D速度从连续两个帧间插出的特征,并在该间隔内将其整合. 在这种帧-pair配制下,每个查询都需要在它之后的帧,因此Uni4R不会预测超越最后的输入帧. 阿达皮克斯 流转则在共享的三维空间中学习一个连续时间动态操作器,从而能够在稀少的观测和观测序列之外进行运动预测。

blocks.en: Learned dynamics models. Another line of work learns predictive dynamics from visual observations using latent particles, RGB-D particle grids, or object slots [ 46 , 57 , 56 , 48 ] . Related approaches model temporal evolution through continuous-time neural dynamics [ 6 , 37 ] or learned operators [ 26 , 5 ] . Several of these models operate on explicit 3D particle or Gaussian states [ 46 , 57 , 56 ] and typically advance them in discrete simulation steps. AdaPixFlow combines a shared metric 3D state, fused from all calibrated views, with a continuous-time dynamics operator that can be queried at any time between and after observations.
blocks.zh: 学习动态模型。 另一行工作利用潜在粒子、RGB-D粒子网格或物体槽[46、57、56、48]从视觉观测中学习预测动力学。 相关方法通过连续时间神经动力学模拟时间演化[6,37]或学习操作员[26,5]. 这些模型中有几个在显式3D粒子或高斯态[46,57,56]上运行,一般在离散的模拟步骤中推进. 阿达皮克斯 流量结合了从所有校准视图中结合到一个共享的度量3D状态,和一个连续的动态运算符,可以在观测之间和之后的任何时候被询问.

blocks.en: Physical dynamics from video. Physical dynamics can also be recovered from video using physics-informed velocity fields [ 22 ] or differentiable simulators of continuum mechanics and spring-mass systems [ 25 , 2 , 58 , 16 ] . Such methods either estimate simulator parameters from observations or take them as given [ 50 ] . Other approaches estimate per-Gaussian velocities [ 24 , 23 , 30 ] . These methods typically optimize scene-specific representations under prescribed dynamics formulations. In contrast, AdaPixFlow learns a continuous-time dynamics operator across scenes and infers a 3D velocity field for a new scene directly from its observations, without scene-specific optimization or a predefined dynamics model.
blocks.zh: 来自视频的物理动态. 物理动力学也可以通过使用物理知情速度场[22]或连续力学和弹簧质量系统的不同模拟器[25,2,58,16]从视频中恢复. 这种方法要么根据观测结果估计模拟参数,要么按给定的[50]进行。 其他方法估计每加澳新的速度[24、23、30]。 这些方法一般在规定的动态配方下优化场景特异性表现. 相比之下,AdaPixFlow学习了跨场景的连续时段动态操作器,并直接从其观测中推断出新场景的3D速度场,没有场景特定优化或预设的动态模型.

blocks.en: Volumetric Fusion of Multi-view Observations. We construct a voxel representation of the scene in world coordinates by fusing observations from all cameras, following the volumetric fusion paradigm [ 9 , 33 ] . The grid covers the region in which the objects of a clip move, at a voxel size shared by all scenes, and its size does not depend on the number of cameras. Each voxel is occupied, free, or unseen.

blocks.en: Our experiments address three questions. (Q1) How does AdaPixFlow compare with methods that optimize scene-specific representations or reconstruct observed frames when predicting object states at unobserved times ( Sec. 4.1 )? (Q2) For which types of motion does learning a dynamics operator provide the greatest benefit, particularly when predicting between observations and beyond the observed sequence ( Sec. 4.2 )? (Q3) Can the learned operator generalize to unseen scenes and datasets without per-scene optimization ( Sec. 4.3 )?
blocks.zh: 我们的实验涉及三个问题。 (问题1) AdaPixFlow 在预测物体在不可观察时间状态时,如何与优化场景特异性表示或重建可观测帧的方法进行比较(第4.1节)? (问题2) 学习动态操作器对哪些类型的运动有最大的好处,特别是在预测观测结果之间和观测序列之外时(第4.2条)? (问题3) 学到的操作员能否在不优化每个场景的情况下,概括到看不见的场景和数据集(第4.3节)?

blocks.en: Setup. We evaluate on PhysInOne [ 59 ] , a multi-view dataset of dynamic scenes designed to study physical phenomena. It covers 71 phenomena and provides RGB images, depth, and segmentation from 12–15 static calibrated cameras per scene. We exclude granular and light phenomena, hold out 10% of the scenes in each of the five tiers of the Train split (continuum, rigid mechanics with one, two, or three phenomena, and invisible forces), and train on 152 of the remaining scenes. We evaluate on 15 held-out Test scenes, 8 Val scenes, and three physics benchmarks not used during training. All baselines are run on six comparison scenes (ElasticFall, DropInLiquid, CrankPush, PanelSpin, DoublePendulum, and BalloonLift), five of which are Test scenes and one, ElasticFall, a Val scene.
blocks.zh: 设置. 我们在PhysIn One[59]上评价,这是一个动态场景的多视图数据集,旨在研究物理现象. 它涵盖71个现象,每个场景提供12–15个静态校准摄像头的RGB图像,深度和分区. 我们排除颗粒现象和光现象,在列车拆分的5个等级中各坚持10%的场景(连续,刚性力学与1,2,或3个现象,以及隐形力),在剩下的152个场景上进行训练. 我们评估了15个暂停试验场景、8个瓦尔场景和三个在训练期间没有使用的物理基准。 所有基线都运行在6个比较场景上(ElasticFall,DropInLiquid,CrankPush,GetalSpin,DoublePendulum,和BalloonLift),其中5个是Test场景,1个是ElasticFall,一个Val场景.

Views 0 and 1 are reserved for novel-view evaluation and are not provided to any method as input. All methods receive the calibrated camera parameters, and each receives the subset of the observed RGB images (RGB), depth maps (D), and moving-object masks (M) listed in Tab. 1 . Paired RGB-D observations are standard in multi-view datasets and capture systems.

For each scene and task, we fit them to the observed RGB views, using depth from the first frame (D 0 ) and masks to select object Gaussians. Training is performed at the 280 px scoring resolution, which may disadvantage both methods (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material).

Since these methods estimate states at observed frames, we interpolate or extrapolate their tracks to obtain predictions at the target times (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material). blocks.en: 4.1 Predicting States at Unobserved Times
blocks.zh: 4.1 无法观察时报的预测国

blocks.en: AdaPixFlow predicts object states more accurately between observations and beyond the observed sequence than the reconstruction and tracking baselines ( Tab. 1 , Figure 3 ). The improvement is particularly pronounced in future prediction, where targets extend up to ten steps beyond the last observation. Quantitatively, AdaPixFlow achieves mean F1 scores of 90.0 in-between and 58.4 in future prediction, compared with 87.8 and 50.7 for STv2, the next-best method.
blocks.zh: AdaPixFlow预测对象在观测值之间和观测序列之外比重建与跟踪基线更精确(Tab. 1,图3 ). 这一改善在今后的预测中尤其明显,即目标比上次观察还远达十步。 数量上, AdaPix 流量实现F1在介于90.0分,在未来预测中达到58.4分,相比之下,STv2为87.8分和50.7分,是次佳方法.

blocks.en: STv2 and OpenD4RT are the closest baselines for in-between prediction. Both track points across observed frames without per-scene optimization, and STv2 outperforms AdaPixFlow on PanelSpin and DoublePendulum. In future prediction, STv2 is slightly more accurate over the first three steps, but AdaPixFlow leads from step four onward (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material). Extrapolating tracks at constant velocity drifts away from curved and accelerating motion. AdaPixFlow predicts all ten future steps from one forward pass. We examine chained prediction passes in the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material.
blocks.zh: STv2 和 OpenD4 数据 RT是预测之间最接近的基线。 两个音轨点都横跨了观测到的帧,没有进行每个场景的优化,STv2在面板Spin和DoublePendulum上都超越了AdaPixFlow. 在未来的预测中,STv2在前三个步骤上略微准确,但AdaPixFlow从第四步向上领先(补充材料中全纸的附录). 恒定速度的外推轨道漂移离开曲线和加速运动. 阿达皮克斯 流量预测了未来所有十步 从一个前进的路程。 我们审查了补充材料全文附录中的连锁预测。

blocks.en: The per-scene dynamics models perform substantially worse despite 0.7–2.2 h of optimization per scene ( Figure 4 ). Their RGB-based reconstructions miss substantial portions of the object even at observed frames, whereas our depth-based fusion provides more complete geometry (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material).
blocks.zh: 尽管每个场景优化0.7-2.2 h(图4),但每场动态模型的表现却大为糟糕。 它们的基于RGB的重建甚至在被观测到的框架里都错过了物体的很大一部分,而我们的深度聚变则提供了更完整的几何学(补充材料中全纸的附录).

blocks.en: 4.2 Motion Underdetermined by the Observations
blocks.zh: 4.2 动议 意见未确定

blocks.en: We examine whether the advantage of AdaPixFlow depends on motion complexity. Using ground-truth states, we divide target times into linear and non-linear subsets according to whether an oracle linear interpolation achieves an F1 of at least 90. For each in-between target, the oracle has access to the exact object states at both ends of the observation gap and selects the best of three interpolation rules: centroid translation, rigid motion with interpolated rotation, or straight-line point trajectories. For future prediction, we use constant-velocity extrapolation from the last two observed states and evaluate targets 4–10 steps ahead. F1 is pooled over all targets in each subset.
blocks.zh: 我们研究AdaPixFlow的优势是否取决于运动的复杂性. 利用地面真实状态,根据甲骨文线性插值是否达到至少90的F1,将目标时间分为线性和非线性子集. 对于每个介于目标之间,甲骨文可以访问观测差距两端的精确对象状态,并选择三个内插规则中最好的:中间体翻译,带有内插旋转的刚性运动,或直线点轨迹. 对于未来的预测,我们使用前两个观测到的状态的恒速推算,并评估前面4 -10步骤的目标。 F1被集合到每个子集的所有目标上.

blocks.en: On linear targets, AdaPixFlow matches or outperforms the strongest trackers on both PhysInOne (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material) and the physics benchmarks ( Tab. 2 ). Its advantage is clearer on non-linear motion: it achieves the highest F1 on non-linear in-between targets across PhysInOne, Spring-Gaus, and PhysGaia, and on future targets 4–10 steps ahead in PhysInOne and Spring-Gaus. This is consistent with how the trackers are applied to unobserved times: we interpolate and extrapolate their tracks linearly in time (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material).
blocks.zh: 在线性目标上,AdaPixFlow匹配或超越了物理学In One(补充材料中全文的附录)和物理基准(Tab. 2 )上最强的跟踪器. 它的优势在非线性运动上更为明确:它在跨物理内线(PhysInOne),春-高斯(Spring-Gaus)和PhysGaia(PhysInOne)的非线性内线目标上,以及未来在物理内线(PhysInOne)和春-高斯(Spring-Gaus)前行4–10步上,实现了最高的F1. 这与追踪器如何应用于无法观察的时间是一致的:我们及时线性地插入并推断它们的轨道(补充材料中全文的附录)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization to Unseen Scenes and Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.3 通向不明场景和数据集

blocks.en: On held-out PhysInOne scenes ( Tab. 3 ), prediction accuracy decreases as the observation spacing increases, while remaining high on the Val scenes despite their differences from the training distribution. On the 15 Test scenes, in-between F1 decreases from 90.9 to 78.7 as the spacing increases from 2 to 8 steps. The 8 Val scenes achieve comparable or higher scores (90.8–99.9), despite having backgrounds and a phenomenon (PlasticineFall) absent from training. Future prediction is less accurate on Val than on Test (55.8 vs. 68.3), as the Val forecast windows include ground contacts.
blocks.zh: 在被搁置的PhysIn One场景(图3)上,预测的准确度随着观测间隔的增大而降低,而Val场景虽然与训练分布有差异,但仍保持较高水平. 在15个测试场景中,由于间隔从2步增加到8步,F1内部从90.9步减少到78.7步. 8 Val场景取得了可比或更高的分数(90.8-99.9),尽管有背景和一种现象(PlasticineFall)没有参加训练. 未来预测在Val比在Test(55.8对68.3)更准确,因为Val预测窗口包括地面接触.

blocks.en: We further evaluate AdaPixFlow without retraining on Spring-Gaus [ 58 ] , PhysGaia [ 17 ] , and Kubric-4D [ 42 , 13 ] . These datasets differ from PhysInOne in object materials, camera configurations, and scene scale. Kubric-4D provides depth and masks. For Spring-Gaus and PhysGaia, we render both from the provided particle data. Across scenes evaluated by all methods (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material), AdaPixFlow achieves the highest accuracy on Spring-Gaus in both tasks and on PhysGaia in-between. On Kubric-4D, it ranks second to STv2, which was trained on Kubric data.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价AdaPixFlow, 不进行春-高斯[58], PhysGaia[17], 和Kubric-4D[42, 13]。 这些数据集在对象材料,相机配置和场景尺度上与PhysIn One不同. Kubric-4D提供深度和口罩. 对于Spring-Gaus和PhysGaia,我们从所提供的粒子数据中提供两者。 AdaPixFlow在Spring-Gaus的任务和PhysGaia的中间都取得了最高的准确性。 在Kubric-4D上,它排在STv2的第二位,后者接受了Kubric数据的培训.

blocks.en: Finally, AdaPixFlow retains much of its performance with estimated rather than dataset-provided depth and masks. Using depth from Depth Anything 3 [ 27 ] and masks from SAM 2.1 [ 40 ] , it achieves F1 scores of 78.5 in-between and 53.3 in future prediction on the comparison scenes. FreeGave, given the same masks, scores 66.5 and 30.0 (the appendix of the full paper in the supplemental material).
blocks.zh: 最后,阿达皮克斯 流动保留了它的大部分性能,有的是估计的,而不是数据集提供的深度和面具。 它利用深度Anything 3[27]和SAM 2.1[40]的口罩,在比较场景中实现了78.5的F1分,在未来预测中达到了53.3分. FreeGave,给同样的口罩,得分66.5和30.0(补充材料中全纸的附录).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: AdaPixFlow demonstrates that a shared continuous-time dynamics operator can predict 3D object motion across scenes from sparse multi-view observations. By combining calibrated geometric reconstruction with a learned velocity field, it predicts states at unobserved times without fitting a separate model to each scene. Experiments on held-out PhysInOne scenes and external physics benchmarks show competitive or improved prediction accuracy over reconstruction, tracking, and per-scene dynamics baselines, with the largest gains for non-linear motion and longer forecasts. These results suggest that learning motion in a shared 3D space provides a useful alternative to interpolating reconstructed trajectories.
blocks.zh: AdaPixFlow显示,共享的连续时动态操作员可以预测3D对象运动从稀少的多视图观测中跨越场景. 通过将校准几何重建与学习速度场相结合,它预测在不观察时段的状态,而不在每个场景中安装单独的模型. 对被搁置的PhysIn One场景和外部物理基准的实验显示,相对于重建、跟踪和每场动态基线,预测准确性具有竞争力或提高,非线性运动和较长的预测收益最大。 这些结果表明,在共享的3D空间中学习运动,为内插重建的轨迹提供了有用的替代办法.

blocks.en: Future work. The current operator models kinematics. Conditioning it on contact and force models would extend it to interactions such as collisions and bounces. Extending the forecast horizon through training on chained predictions is another direction. Finally, applying AdaPixFlow to real multi-view captures will require handling errors in estimated depth and segmentation.
blocks.zh: 未来工作。 目前的操作员模式为动能学. 将接触和力模型作为条件,将它扩大到碰撞和反弹等相互作用。 通过连锁预测培训扩大预测视野是另一个方向。 最后,将AdaPixFlow应用到真实的多视图抓取需要处理估计深度和分区的错误.

blocks.en: To forecast beyond 10 steps, we chain 10-step passes and condition each pass on the last two predicted states, two steps apart. Accuracy drops beyond 10 steps ( Figure 9 ), whereas a pass restarted from an observed state stays accurate. This is expected, since the operator is trained on observed rather than predicted states, and it is why we evaluate forecasts up to 10 steps in the main text. We verified the chaining itself: its first pass equals the 10-step forecast, and a pass restarted from the ground-truth state stays within 0.4–4 voxels on ElasticFall in mid-flight. Two scenes account for the drop. In ElasticFall, the flow continues through the floor after the bounce (16 voxels of error at step 9 against 11 voxels of motion), and in the chaotic DoublePendulum, the centroid error reaches 34 voxels beyond 10 steps against 27 voxels of motion. Since the window of Figure 9 differs from that of Tab. 1 , its first bin is not comparable with the main results.

blocks.en: With the estimated fusion, using Depth Anything 3 depth and SAM 2.1 masks, AdaPixFlow stays above FreeGave labeled with the same masks in both tasks. Depth is the most influential input. Finally, AdaPixFlow stays below the accuracy of its own input fusion in every row, because the flow can only move the object points that the fusion contains.

blocks.en: Inference. Algorithm 1 summarizes inference. The first gap of in-between prediction has no preceding observation, so we set k p = k 0 k_{p}=k_{0} there. Within a gap, the forward and backward flows share one velocity field, which sees both neighboring observations, and we predict each step in a single direction.

Predicted states and images. We round the advected points to the nearest voxel and drop the points that leave the evaluation window. Each predicted voxel carries the color of its source voxel, with occupancy and objectness set to one and the unseen flag to zero, and we place these voxels over the static voxels 𝒮 \mathcal{S} , where the latest observed color wins.
To render images, we work with pixels rather than voxels. We back-project the object pixels of all observed views from their depth at the observation, advect them along the same velocity field, and render them as points into the target camera at twice the image resolution. A z-buffer averages the points near the front surface, weighted by the angle between the source and target viewing directions, so that a training view mostly keeps its own pixels. The covered fraction of each pixel gives the object opacity A A , and A > 0.5 A>0.5 defines the silhouette. We composite the object color C ^ \hat{C} over a static image B B built only from observed data, I = C ^ ​ A + B ⁡ ( 1 − A ) I=\hat{C}A+B(1-A) . For training views, B B takes at each pixel the observed image nearest in time in which the pixel is not part of an object. For novel views, we reproject the non-object depth points of the training views with a z-buffer and fill holes by normalized convolution. Points behind the static depth are hidden. blocks.en: Training. We build the training targets by fusing all cameras of a training scene, 12, or 15 for special materials, and use them only as unordered object points per step. The network never sees a fusion from fewer views or from estimated depth during training, so such test inputs differ from the training distribution. We draw source points from the initial observation for forward targets and, when the next observation is given, from that observation for backward targets. Advected points outside the crop are left out of the prediction-to-target term of the Chamfer distance, and we do not supervise color. We found the redraw of training windows necessary: without it, a preliminary run on the same scenes collapsed to predicting no motion by step 3,000.
blocks.zh: 培训。 我们通过安装训练场的所有摄像头来建造训练目标, 12或15个用于特殊材料, 并且每个步骤只作为无序物体点使用。 该网络从不从较少的视角或培训期间的估计深度看到融合,因此这种测试投入与培训分配不同。 我们从对前方目标的初步观察中汲取源点,并在作出下一次观察时从对落后目标的观察中汲取源点。 作物外的附着点 被忽略在 Champfer 距离的预测-目标术语之外, 我们不监督颜色。 我们发现重新绘制训练窗口是必要的:没有它,在同一场景上的初步运行会崩溃,无法预测3000步的动静.

blocks.en: Design choices. Our design follows from preliminary experiments with earlier models. Blending fused states per voxel, or interpolating values at fixed positions, cross-faded objects instead of moving them. Even a continuous-time operator trained on spline paths in a fused feature space reached only the IoU of per-voxel blending (0.79). Rolling out from the first observation compounded errors, reaching an IoU of 0.34 over 22 intervals, although each interval alone reached 1.00 from its true start. We therefore move points, start each prediction from an observation, and condition the field on both neighboring observations.
blocks.zh: 设计选择. 我们的设计是基于早期模型的初步实验。 混合每伏克赛尔的引信状态,或者在固定位置插值,交叉变形物体而不是移动它们. 甚至一个连续的操作员在引信的特性空间中接受过丝状路径培训,但只达到每伏瑟尔混合的IoU(0.79)。 从第一次观察中推出的复合误差,在22个间隔内达到0.34的IoU,虽然每个间隔从真正开始就达到1.00. 因此,我们移动点,从一个观察开始每个预测, 并且把现场作为两个邻近观测条件。

blocks.en: E.2 Uni4R’s Formulation under Sparse Observations
blocks.zh: E.2 Uni4R 的 Sparse 观察的配方

blocks.en:
Uni4R [ 52 ] releases no code, so we test its formulation with a reduced reimplementation rather than the method itself.
Following its Sec. 3, we treat every pixel of an input frame as an anchor point. We interpolate features along a straight line between consecutive input frames, decode a per-pixel 3D velocity from them and the query time, and integrate it with Euler steps of 0.1 from the preceding frame. We train with its integral-consistency and flow-matching losses. Our model is smaller than Uni4R. It uses a DINOv2 ViT-S/14 encoder [ 34 ] , has 54 M parameters in total, and is trained for 4.5 h on one GPU on 118 Kubric-4D training scenes, whose rigid object poses give the ground-truth 3D position of every pixel at every frame. Like the other adapted methods, it reads the depth of the observed views, from which we obtain its anchor points.
blocks.zh:
Uni4R [52] 没有发布代码,所以我们用减少的重实施来测试它的配方,而不是方法本身.
在它的Sec. 3之后,我们将一个输入框的每个像素作为锚点处理. 我们在连续的输入帧之间沿直线插图特征,从它们和查询时间中解码出每像素3D速度,并将其与前帧0.1的欧乐步融合. 我们训练的是它的整体一致性和流量匹配的损失。 我们的型号比Uni4R小. 它使用DINov2 VIT-S/14编码器[34],总共拥有54 M参数,并在118 Kubric-4D训练场景的一个GPU上接受4.5 h的训练,其刚性物体的构成使每个像素在每个帧的地面真实3D位置. 与其他经过调整的方法一样,它读取了所观察到的观点的深度,我们从这些观点中得到了它的锚点。

blocks.en: We train it twice with the same budget, once on consecutive frames only, as Uni4R does, and once on inputs spaced 1 to 8 steps apart, as AdaPixFlow does. Each training view is a separate input, and we unite the points of all views and score them as in Tab. 14 , averaging over the scenes with scored targets (five at s = 4 s{=}4 and six otherwise).

blocks.en: When trained on consecutive frames, the model barely moves the points between sparse observations. It improves on holding the preceding observation, from which it integrates, by 6.4 F1 points at a spacing of 4 and by 2.8 at a spacing of 8, compared with 12.8 and 9.2 when trained on sparse spacings ( Tab. 6 ). AdaPixFlow integrates from the nearer observation and improves on holding it by 8.7 and 8.9 points. Beyond the last frame, where we extend Uni4R’s feature interpolation past the last input, neither variant improves on holding the last observation by more than 0.4 points, whereas AdaPixFlow improves on it by 12.4. Since our reimplementation is much smaller than Uni4R, these numbers describe how its formulation responds to sparse sampling, not Uni4R’s own accuracy.
